newsitem.title: USA: FERC rejects Wash. Water Power retail pilot.
newsitem.headline: FERC rejects Wash. Water Power retail pilot.

text.p: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) decided Washington Water Power Co's retail wheeling pilot does not meet terms for open-access transmission tariffs, a company spokesman confirmed Monday.

WWP had argued that the pilot program for customers in Washington and Idaho did not constitute unbundled retail service, maintaining that it simply separated a portion of the commodity component of retail service.
But FERC said the proposed tariffs come under its jurisdiction.
"We are still looking at the order to determine what it means," the WWP spokesman said, noting a response will probably be made in a week or two.

The utility's direct access pilot program for large industrial customers is already underway and a proposed pilot for residential and small commercial customers was filed with state regulators earlier this month.
